title: Phase closeout
canonical_definition: Reconcile the complete accumulated CMP-5 external distributed-compute adapter phase against current main, establish one exact merge-candidate implementation SHA, run the required Level 3 qualification once, preserve durable evidence, and hand off to CMP-6 — Useful-computation rewards.

ci_ownership.solidity_full_inventory: Solidity Contracts / four balanced PR shards
ci_ownership.genesis_address_authority: Genesis Address Authority / no duplicate full Foundry

non_applicable_direct_clients.420-indexer: CMP-5 introduces no new indexer schema, ingestion, discovery, or event-consumer implementation; indexed external-compute discovery remains CMP-7.
non_applicable_direct_clients.420-rpc: CMP-5 introduces no RPC method, schema, or backend surface.
non_applicable_direct_clients.420Search: CMP-5 introduces no Search consumer or indexing implementation.
non_applicable_direct_clients.frontend/backend: CMP-5 introduces protocol adapters and attestation/consumption contracts, not the human-facing CMP-8 application.
non_applicable_direct_clients.@420/sdk: CMP-5 introduces no SDK surface; direct SDK qualification is not applicable unless a later change modifies packages/420-sdk.

live_blockers: live external attester governance onboarding and ProtocolRegistry publication remain deployment/testnet scope
provider-specific external evidence-validation services remain operational/testnet scope
funded useful-computation reward economics and payout integration remain CMP-6 scope
public/testnet external-compute workload demonstration remains CMP-9 scope
